title: Database Migration Strategies
description: Migrate on-premises SQL Server to Azure SQL with minimal downtime.

data.text: You have a 500GB SQL Server database with 50 connected applications. You need to migrate to Azure SQL Database with <4 hours downtime. The database has stored procedures, SQL Agent jobs, and Service Broker queues.

Use **Azure Database Migration Service (DMS)** for the migration. For SQL Server with advanced features, consider **Azure SQL Managed Instance** instead of Azure SQL Database. Use **Active Geo-Replication** for minimal downtime cutover.

data.title: Migration Steps
data.code:
1. Assess with Data Migration Assistant (DMA)
   - Check compatibility
   - Identify blocking issues
   - Review performance recommendations

2. Provision Azure SQL Managed Instance
   - Choose vCore-based SKU
   - Configure backup redundancy

3. Run DMS Migration
   - Online migration mode
   - Sync changes during cutover

4. Cutover
   - Stop applications
   - Final sync
   - Update connection strings
   - Resume applications

data.text: Why Managed Instance for Complex Databases

**Azure SQL Managed Instance** supports SQL Agent, Service Broker, Database Mail, and cross-database queries. **Azure SQL Database** does not. For complex migrations, Managed Instance is the closest match to on-premises SQL Server.

cards.title: Azure SQL Managed Instance
cards.description: Full SQL Server compatibility in PaaS
pros: SQL Agent and SQL Server Agent
